overloads.semanticRole: Computes the arithmetic mean of series (an indexed field, an object-field attribute selected via attributePath, or a numeric array).

constraints: If series is an array, it must be a one- or two-dimension Integer/Longint/Real array (not Text/Boolean/etc).
attributePath only applies when series is an object field; it selects a (possibly nested, dot-notation, case-sensitive) numeric attribute, and non-numeric values along that path are ignored.
Sets the OK system variable to 1 on normal completion, or 0 if the user interrupts via the progress thermometer's Stop button.
